$comment: CANONICAL DESIGN TOKENS — single source of truth for the entire desktop.
Nothing downstream hardcodes a colour, spacing value, duration or easing curve.
Edit this file, then run `design/build-tokens.py` to regenerate every consumer:
sddm/themes/gelo-liquid/Theme/Tokens.qml (SDDM login theme — separate QML import root)
All four generated files carry a do-not-edit header and are checked in, so a fresh
clone works without running the generator.

color.$comment: Accent appears in EXACTLY three places system-wide: active workspace indicator, focused window border, cursor. This restraint is intentional and load-bearing — do not add a fourth.

space.$comment: 4px base grid. Every gap, padding and margin in every component snaps to this scale.

radius.$comment: Snapped to the 4px grid. `full` is the pill/blob terminal value.

type.$fontComment: Mono = bar, launcher, lock screen. Sans = login screen only.

weight.$comment: 400 default, 500 for emphasis only. Never 700 — bold is not in this system.

motion.$comment: expo-out — matches the existing GSAP work on the portfolio site.

$comment: Liquid glass. A reusable material, not a one-off effect — applied identically to the
bar, launcher, notification cards and login field.
Depth comes from a soft large-radius low-opacity SHADOW, never from a fake gradient
'shine'. That distinction is what reads as Apple rather than 2014 Windows Aero.
On interaction the corner radius RELAXES OUTWARD (rest -> hover -> press) rather than
snapping to a fixed hover state. The morph itself is the affordance.

blob.$comment: Signature micro-interaction. `overshoot` is the elastic settle past target before resolving; `squash` is the non-uniform scale applied on press/dismiss.
